全年轨迹连接每日同一时刻的位置：粉紫色为太阳、绿色为杆尖的影子。只在有直射阳光时: Annual curves connect positions at the same time each day: purple for the Sun and green for the gnomon's shadow tip. Shadow paths are drawn only in direct sunlight and clipped outside the ground circle. Fixing apparent solar time makes the solar hour angle nearly constant, so this seasonal path usually differs from the figure eight obtained at a fixed clock time.
切到俯视日影，拖动时间；在“显示辅助 → 日影与杆尖影迹”中可放大地面、显示全天: Choose Shadow plan view and drag the time slider. Under Display aids → Shadows and shadow-tip paths, enlarge the ground, show the daily tip path, and click it to change time. A vertical gnomon's shadow on level ground points away from the Sun. Gnomon height affects shadow length, not the observer's elevation.
切到月相界面，先看月面亮暗与日地月关系，按天推进日期，在固定观测时刻比较月相与天: Choose Moon phases to explore illumination and Sun–Earth–Moon geometry. Advance dates while keeping the observation time fixed to compare phases and sky positions. Choose Moon sky for its apparent motion, or overlay the Moon in the Sun view. The phase cycle is about 29.53 days, not one calendar month. The Moon can also appear in the daytime sky.
动手比较：保持日期不变，把经度从 120°E 改到 105°E，观察同一当地真太: Try it: keep the date fixed and change longitude from 120°E to 105°E. Compare clock readings at the same local apparent solar time. Then keep the location fixed and change the date to explore the equation of time.
可切换太阳和月球。圆点代表地面观察位置。轨迹是在该观察者眼中，天体当天经过的路径: Switch between the Sun and Moon. The dot represents the observer on the ground. The curve shows the body's daily path as seen by that observer.

Install the disk at the tilt shown above so the rod is parallel to Earth's axis; do not lay the disk horizontally.

Align it with true north–south and set its elevation as shown above, pointing toward your hemisphere's celestial pole. Draw hour lines for the current latitude; do not copy the equally spaced marks of an ordinary clock.
固定北京，依次选夏至、冬至，或拖动全年月份滑块，观察正午高度和昼长。季节主要由地: Keep Beijing selected. Compare the June and December solstices, or drag the annual month slider to examine noon altitude and daylight duration. Seasons primarily result from Earth's axial tilt changing solar altitude and daylight duration, not from changing Earth–Sun distance.
在太阳界面开启“固定时刻 · 按日期观察”，拖动全年日期或按日期播放，比较太阳与: In the Sun view, enable fixed-time date observations. Drag the annual date slider or play dates to compare the Sun and gnomon shadow. Overlay annual paths at the same time and link the analemma below. This keeps local apparent solar time fixed, not Beijing clock time.
在太阳的“关联图解 → 生活装置”中进入日晷独立实验页。拖动时间或盘面上的影子、: Open the standalone Sundial lab from the Sun's linked diagrams. Drag time or the shadow on the dial, or play a day, to compare both instruments. Change the gnomon length to examine shadows and time readings. Sundial gnomons are parallel to Earth's axis and read local apparent solar time, which differs from a phone's clock time.

The analemma can use its own time; linked daily observations use the main lab's apparent solar time. The UTC offset is fixed and excludes daylight saving time.
在月相界面开启演示，选择行星，比较同一地点和时刻的球面角距与高度。可寻找未来 3: In Moon phases, enable the conjunction demonstration and select a planet. Compare spherical angular separation and altitude at the same location and time. Find the closest date in the next 30 days at that fixed time. A conjunction does not mean the planet and Moon are close in space, and small angular separation does not guarantee easy naked-eye viewing.

开启影迹会切到俯视日影。杆尖影迹指杆尖的影子在地面上随时间移动的轨迹；太阳在地平: Enabling the shadow path switches to Shadow plan view. The path traces the gnomon tip's shadow moving across the ground over time. No direct-sunlight shadow is drawn when the Sun is below the horizon.
放大只调整画面的地面比例，影长仍按真实米数显示；同一倍率下，比例不随时间或杆高自: Zoom changes only the displayed ground scale; shadow lengths remain in real meters. At a fixed zoom, scale does not automatically change with time or gnomon height. The model assumes level ground and a vertical gnomon. Paths outside the circle are clipped, not connected along its edge.
方位—高度展开图，画面距离不等于球面角距；虚线只用于关联标记。圆点只表示方向位置: This azimuth–altitude chart's screen distances are not spherical angular separations. Dashed lines only link markers, and dots indicate directions without testing occultation or obstruction. Close approaches are enlarged. The phase icon does not show the Moon's local orientation. The ≤5° threshold is a viewing reference, not a universal definition of conjunction. Searches compare a fixed time each day, not the exact conjunction instant.
日晷把太阳方向变成时间。这里的晷针与地轴平行，和前面用于观察影长的竖直立杆不同；: Sundials turn the Sun's direction into a time reading. Their gnomons are parallel to Earth's axis, unlike the vertical gnomon used for shadow lengths. The equatorial gnomon passes through the dial so both faces can be used. Both instruments share the current location, date, and local apparent solar time.
日晷读出当地真太阳时。手机通常显示所在时区的钟表时；地点经度相对时区中央经线的差: A sundial reads local apparent solar time. A phone usually shows its time zone's clock time. Longitude relative to the zone's central meridian and the changing equation of time both cause differences. This model uses a fixed UTC offset and does not automatically apply daylight saving time.
日期观测下保持当地真太阳时，主界面显示全年日期滑动条；太阳位置与杆影同步变化。: In ephemeris mode, keep local apparent solar time fixed and use the annual date slider. The Sun's position and gnomon shadow change together.
时刻线一般不等距，排列随纬度变化。晷针仰角等于当地纬度的绝对值；此装置搬到其他纬: Hour lines are generally unevenly spaced and depend on latitude. The gnomon's elevation equals the absolute latitude. Recalibrate the instrument if you move it to another latitude.
时间采用当地真太阳时，太阳上中天约在 12:00（理想实验恰为 12:00）；不: Time is local apparent solar time: the Sun transits near 12:00 (exactly 12:00 in the idealized experiment), rather than your phone's time-zone clock. Ephemeris mode uses astronomical calculations. Seasonal buttons select solstice and equinox local dates for the current year; their names and comparison-line labels follow Northern Hemisphere seasons, which are reversed in the Southern Hemisphere. The idealized experiment fixes solar declination to study latitude and seasons; selected date and UTC are not used. Comparison curves use ideal declinations of 0° and ±23.44°. Lunar calculations include topocentric parallax, placing the observer on the ground rather than at Earth's center. Both bodies rise or set when their centers cross the geometric horizon; atmospheric refraction and terrain obstruction are omitted. Lunar illumination is the lit fraction of the disk seen from Earth, using a geocentric apparent-phase approximation. “Near” a principal phase does not identify its exact instant. Eclipse obstruction and brightness changes are not simulated. Elapsed durations in ephemeris mode use UTC intervals and differ slightly from apparent-solar-time reading intervals. Phase icons use a fixed orientation rather than the locally observed bright-limb orientation, which depends on hemisphere and observation time. A day's maximum altitude can occur at the 00:00 or 24:00 boundary and need not coincide with lunar upper transit. A lunar direction and altitude do not guarantee naked-eye visibility; new moons and daytime conditions can make viewing difficult. Some azimuths are not uniquely defined at the poles or zenith.
点击盘面时刻刻度；聚焦画布后可用键盘：← / → 调整一小时，Home 回到正午: Click an hour mark on the dial. With the canvas focused, ← / → adjust by one hour and Home returns to solar noon. The 3D instrument uses the same geometry; Dial reading and installation retains orthographic views. Gnomon length is adjustable (default horizontal length 0.18 m; equatorial length 0.18 m on each side), and dial radius is 0.32 m. Arrows show a shadow tip outside the dial. Align installations with true north–south; correct a magnetic compass for magnetic declination. Directions at the poles are not unique, so the selected meridian is used as a reference. Shadows are calculated from ray–dial intersections; line width and soft edges aid visibility without simulating actual penumbra, weather, or terrain obstruction.

地平面与当地天顶垂直。改变纬度会改变地轴相对当地地平面的倾斜；改变日期和时刻会改: The horizon plane is perpendicular to the local zenith. Changing latitude changes Earth's axis relative to that plane; changing date and time changes the Sun's direction relative to it.

太阳轨迹与<strong>地平线相切</strong>，没有通常意义上穿越地平线: The Sun's path is tangent to the horizon, so there is no ordinary sunrise or sunset crossing. This idealized limiting case excludes atmospheric refraction.

天体轨迹是单位方向球的投影，不是地面的米制位置；地面圆单独使用下方标明的米制比例: Celestial paths project directions on a unit sphere, not ground positions in meters. The ground circle separately uses the metric scale stated below. No finite direct-sunlight shadow exists when the Sun is below or along the horizon; shadow length is zero at zenith.
按天体几何中心穿越高度角 0° 的理想地平线计算，未计大气折射、天体视半径和地形: Calculated when the body's geometric center crosses an ideal horizon at altitude 0°. Atmospheric refraction, apparent angular radius, and terrain obstruction are omitted.
方位角从正北顺时针量起；按天体中心穿越几何地平线计算，未计大气折射。: Azimuth is measured clockwise from north. Rise/set uses the body's center crossing the geometric horizon, without atmospheric refraction.
时长按当日对应的 UTC 时间间隔统计。: Duration is measured from the corresponding UTC intervals for that day.
月球反射太阳光，通常约有一半表面受太阳照射；照明比例指地球所见月圆盘的亮面面积比: The Moon reflects sunlight, which normally illuminates about half its surface. The illumination fraction is the lit area of the lunar disk seen from Earth, not the fraction of the Moon's entire surface receiving light. This uses a geocentric apparent-phase approximation; “near” identifies proximity to a phase, not its exact instant. Moon phases are not caused by Earth's shadow. Distances, sizes, and orbit are schematic. The actual orbit is inclined, so new and full moons do not always produce eclipses; eclipse obstruction and brightness changes are not simulated.
月球地平视差已计入；实际月出、月落时刻仍可能不同。: Topocentric lunar parallax is included; actual moonrise and moonset times can still differ.
月球轨迹覆盖所选日期的 00:00—24:00；月球沿轨道运动，一天后天空位置不: The lunar path covers 00:00–24:00 on the selected date. Orbital motion changes its sky position after a day, so the endpoints generally do not meet; gaps are not missing drawing. Consecutive upper transits average about 24 hours 50 minutes apart, but the interval varies. Date playback compares positions at the same time. Dashed paths are below the horizon; rise/set uses center crossings of the geometric horizon, without refraction.
月相图标是固定朝向的示意，不代表本地月面朝向。: The phase icon uses a fixed illustrative orientation, not the Moon's locally observed orientation.
杆尖影迹记录这一天有直射阳光时，竖直杆尖在水平地面上的影子位置；不是杆尖本身移动: The shadow-tip path records the tip's shadow on level ground during direct sunlight that day; the gnomon itself does not move. Dots mark whole hours. Click the path in plan view to change time. Sections outside the ground circle are clipped; reduce zoom to see more.
极点在分日处于<strong>临界状态</strong>：理想模型中太阳沿地平线: At the poles, equinoxes form a limiting case: the idealized Sun follows the horizon, so ordinary sunrise/set times do not describe it.
极点的正北方向不能唯一确定，图中不赋予升落方位。升落以天体中心穿越几何地平线为准: North is not uniquely defined at the poles, so rise/set azimuths are not assigned. Rise/set uses the body's center crossing the geometric horizon, without refraction.

例如：北京夏至附近，太阳从东北升起、西北落下。面向南时，升落位置在身后，因此前方: For example, near the June solstice in Beijing, the Sun rises in the northeast and sets in the northwest. When facing south, those locations are behind you, so the visible path can end in the sky. Turn east, north, or west to compare.

A conjunction does not mean the planet and Moon are close in space, and small angular separation does not guarantee easy naked-eye viewing.

Dashed lines only link markers, and dots indicate directions without testing occultation or obstruction. Close approaches are enlarged. The phase icon does not show the Moon's local orientation. The ≤5° threshold is a viewing reference, not a universal definition of conjunction. Searches compare a fixed time each day, not the exact conjunction instant.
日晷读出当地真太阳时。手机通常显示所在时区的钟表时；地点经度相对时区中央经线的差: A sundial reads local apparent solar time. A phone usually shows its time zone's clock time. Longitude relative to the zone's central meridian and the changing equation of time both cause differences. This model uses a fixed UTC offset and does not automatically apply daylight saving time.
时间采用当地真太阳时，太阳上中天约在 12:00（理想实验恰为\n: Time is local apparent solar time: the Sun transits near 12:00 (exactly 12:00 in the idealized experiment), rather than your phone's time-zone clock. Ephemeris mode uses astronomical calculations. Seasonal buttons select solstice and equinox local dates for the current year; their names and comparison-line labels follow Northern Hemisphere seasons, which are reversed in the Southern Hemisphere. The idealized experiment fixes solar declination to study latitude and seasons; selected date and UTC are not used. Comparison curves use ideal declinations of 0° and ±23.44°. Lunar calculations include topocentric parallax, placing the observer on the ground rather than at Earth's center. Both bodies rise or set when their centers cross the geometric horizon; atmospheric refraction and terrain obstruction are omitted. Lunar illumination is the lit fraction of the disk seen from Earth, using a geocentric apparent-phase approximation. “Near” a principal phase does not identify its exact instant. Eclipse obstruction and brightness changes are not simulated. Elapsed durations in ephemeris mode use UTC intervals and differ slightly from apparent-solar-time reading intervals. Phase icons use a fixed orientation rather than the locally observed bright-limb orientation, which depends on hemisphere and observation time. A day's maximum altitude can occur at the 00:00 or 24:00 boundary and need not coincide with lunar upper transit. A lunar direction and altitude do not guarantee naked-eye visibility; new moons and daytime conditions can make viewing difficult. Some azimuths are not uniquely defined at the poles or zenith.
点击盘面时刻刻度；聚焦画布后可用键盘：← / → 调整一小时，Home\n: Click an hour mark on the dial. With the canvas focused, ← / → adjust by one hour and Home returns to solar noon. The 3D instrument uses the same geometry; Dial reading and installation retains orthographic views. Gnomon length is adjustable (default horizontal length 0.18 m; equatorial length 0.18 m on each side), and dial radius is 0.32 m. Arrows show a shadow tip outside the dial. Align installations with true north–south; correct a magnetic compass for magnetic declination. Directions at the poles are not unique, so the selected meridian is used as a reference. Shadows are calculated from ray–dial intersections; line width and soft edges aid visibility without simulating actual penumbra, weather, or terrain obstruction.
